title: Best of Bali Honeymoon with Seminyak
alt: Sunset over the beach at Seminyak, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Mount Batur and the temples
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek
activities.description: A guided climb up the volcano in the dark to reach the rim for sunrise, with breakfast cooked in the steam vents at the top.

activities.name: Temple tour with the monkey forest
activities.description: A private day taking in Taman Ayun, the Alas Kedaton monkey forest and the cliff temple at Uluwatu, with Padang Padang beach on the way.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the south coast to begin, with a sunrise climb up Mount Batur and a temple day that ends on the Uluwatu cliffs.

stops.name: Seminyak
stops.subtitle: Seminyak to Tanjung Benoa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Pool hotel in Seminyak, a short walk from Eat Street

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your first afternoon in Seminyak, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a private spa.

activities.name: Water sports at Tanjung Benoa
activities.description: A half day combo at Tanjung Benoa with banana boat, jet ski and parasailing, all with life jackets and an instructor in the water.

activities.name: Sunset dinner cruise
activities.description: A half day cruise out of Benoa harbour with dinner on board and live music, timed for sunset over the Bukit peninsula.

activities.name: Seminyak beach and Eat Street
activities.description: The long grey sand beach with its beach clubs, and the restaurants of Jalan Kayu Aya a few minutes inland for a last dinner out.

program.name: Seminyak
program.description: Three nights in Seminyak with a couples massage, water sports at Tanjung Benoa, a sunset cruise with dinner and a private candlelight dinner.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
First evening free on the south coast
Optional: the night market, Kuta theatre or Karma beach
2: Very early start for the guided climb up Mount Batur
Sunrise on the crater rim above the lake
Breakfast cooked in the volcanic steam at the top
Back at the hotel by midday for a slow afternoon
3: Breakfast, then a private day among the temples
Taman Ayun and the Alas Kedaton monkey forest
Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Seminyak
Check in and a traditional Balinese massage for two
Optional: dinner along Eat Street or Jalan Laksmana
5: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Sunset dinner cruise out of Benoa harbour
Live music and dinner on board as the light goes
6: Breakfast and a full day free in Seminyak
Optional: a beach club afternoon or the Nyaman gallery
Candlelight dinner for two in the evening, set up privately
Optional: a late walk along Double Six beach
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Kuta first, Seminyak second. The second half is quieter, smarter and exactly where a honeymoon should finish.
expert.tip: Do the Batur climb on your first full day while you are still on Indian time, it makes the two in the morning start far easier. Keep Seminyak for late dinners and nothing more demanding.

summary: Seven days for two across the south coast: three nights in Kuta with a sunrise climb up Mount Batur and a temple day at Uluwatu, then three in Seminyak with a couples massage, water sports, a sunset cruise and a candlelight dinner.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Mount Batur sunrise trek; temple tour with the monkey forest and Uluwatu; Balinese massage for two; water sports at Tanjung Benoa; sunset dinner cruise; candlelight dinner.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
